items.title: Marvell Stock Had A Huge Year And Still Sits Well Below Its High
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) stock returned 235.9% over the past year, climbing from $62.18 to $208.83. The company kept raising what it expects to sell, and buyers repriced it each time. Then the shares pulled back, and they now sit well below their best.

items.title: Why Is Qualcomm (QCOM) Backing A $70 Million Bet On Smart Rings?
items.summary: Qualcomm (NasdaqGS:QCOM) has backed health tech company Ultrahuman in a $70m funding round to build a next generation smart ring powered by Qualcomm chips. The Qualcomm powered ring is intended to run complex software, including on device AI features and device control functions. The investment points to a wider Qualcomm push into advanced wearables beyond its core smartphone chipset business. items.title: How Far AMD Stock Can Swing In Its Calm Case
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) trades at about $456.16, and its option chain has already put numbers on how far the stock can travel from here. Over roughly the next 380 days that chain marks out a band running from $260 to $792.23. The width is what matters if you hold the shares. That is the risk you are carrying, whichever way it breaks.

items.title: Marvell Rises 6% as Beaten-Down AI Silicon Bounces, Qualcomm Barely Budges
items.summary: AI silicon stocks are splitting sharply on Friday, with one beaten-down chip designer surging while a larger rival barely moves. The divergence reveals something important about which companies actually benefit when hyperscaler spending accelerates.

items.title: Cirrus Logic (CRUS) Down 8.4% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Rebound?
items.summary: Cirrus Logic (CRUS) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: QCOM Showered Owners With Cash. The Stock Still Lagged The Market
items.summary: The chipmaker showered its owners with cash while the stock price went nowhere fast, raising a sharp question about what all that money actually bought.

items.title: Qualcomm Lost a Third of Its Value in 3 Months. One Wall Street Pro Sees 140% Upside From Here
items.summary: Qualcomm has lost nearly a third of its value while its semiconductor peers surged, leaving one Wall Street analyst staking a reputation on a price target that towers over every other major forecast in the group.

items.title: Should You Buy Marvell Stock Because Its Operating Margin Keeps Widening?
items.summary: Marvell Technology (MRVL) lifted its revenue outlook for fiscal 2027 and fiscal 2028 in its late-August report. The stock, at about $206, is up more than 220% over the past twelve months and down about 32% over the past three months. The bear case is the gross margin, and management supplied the number. The counter sits one line further down, in an operating margin that has widened two years running.
